message: Added ECC as an opt-in multi-harness catalog skill; setup now requires explicit provider target, scope, hook, and duplicate-install checks.
Added Headroom as a full-mode context layer: reuse healthy deployment state, keep Graphify preflight read-only, and enforce source edits only through the documented Claude Code hook.

Catalog 251->358: vendored pm-skills(65+1), langchain-skills(10), higgsfield-ai(8), k-skill(5), oh-my-gods(17) at pinned commits; oh-my-gods vendored despite agenticskills installer because user chose standalone jeo-skill install. Excluded previously-removed/retired skills, OMC/OMX/ooo command shims, router-covered sub-skills, and 6 unattributed singles. Restored llm-wiki knowledge-pipeline hooks in setup Step 5; committed generate-catalog-projections.py; .mex/ and root anchors stay untracked by user choice.

Promoted the independent shopping-shorts account skill into the canonical 359-skill catalog after portability cleanup and 79-case media regression validation; kept 26 retired or deliberately deleted global leftovers excluded. Pushed commit 2830081 to main.

Duplicate audit 359->350: merged 9 same-JTBD pairs into canonical skills (content absorbed into references/, old names in retired_skills, route-outs repointed); adjacent-but-different overlaps declared as relationship_groups (llm-observability, bug-diagnosis, product-analytics) rather than merged; upstream sibling splits and provider choices left alone.

Installer compatibility uses shared jeopi/JEO/OMP roots but projects selected files into GJC-native, Aside-account and separate AGY CLI/IDE roots. Actual skills@1.7.0 writes proved advertised target metadata alone is insufficient. Verified isolated real installs and session loaders; provider plugins/hooks unchanged.

Installer documentation must be exercised, not merely parsed: a trailing JEO_SKILLS_DRY_RUN=true argument passed bash syntax checks while installing. Added offline fixture execution of both documented preview commands with unchanged-filesystem assertions; standalone legacy shared-router upgrade regression also passes. Public recipes must use a documented checkout root. Actual user HOME and ECC settings remain untouched.

Installer follow-up verified exact documented preview and apply commands, preserving minimal/core/full runtime selections. Shell syntax alone missed an environment assignment after the command; behavioral fixture tests now guard it. All 34 installer, 6 loader-probe, and 24 configuration-writer checks passed. Actual user installations and ECC settings unchanged.

Ubuntu CI caught GNU stat -f filesystem output contaminating Agentation's inline permission fallback. Adopted existing plannotator Darwin/GNU mode dispatch in Agentation and the test helper, preserving exact 640/600 assertions. Obsidian's separate command assignments are not affected. Local configuration suite24 passes; corrective remote CI pending.

Router review: explicit catalog overrides fail closed across browse/install/doctor; share bounded Node/npx prerequisites so doctor cannot report false readiness; reject negative search limits. No npm release was invented: this repo distributes via GitHub and has no root package target.

Context-layer lifecycle policy decided via Path B interview (MCP timed out): hybrid triggers (TaskCompleted inline + SessionEnd detached refresh; per-repo pre-push checkpoint chained before git-lfs), archive-then-30d-TTL for authored pages, raw/ exempt, regenerable caches deleted+rebuilt, per-layer locks shared with ingest producers, single vault SSoT ~/vaults/llm-wiki, graphify-out/ canonical with deletion-aware reconciliation, mex-agent 0.8.3 upgrade. Seed + 6 research reports under .ouroboros/.

ctx lifecycle tool implemented and verified (12/12 seed ACs, 6 self-tests). Ouroboros run cancelled: worktree containment nulls out-of-repo context refs, so the seed was executed directly via 4 parallel builders. Design facts: zg status rewrites index segments (plan() must never shell out); SessionEnd 1.5s budget -> detached refresh; pre-push hook resolved via git rev-parse --git-path for linked worktrees; .moving consolidation dirs resumable, never rmtree; orphan-index GC fails closed on any surviving root or live lease. 3 real checkpoints: 42.6MB deleted, 27 pages + 2 roots archived, raw/ byte-identical.

Jev remains an explicit home-scoped opt-in, separate from catalog transport and host rule adoption. Configuration/readiness are distinct; outages and malformed decisions fail closed. Verified a real local Ollama prune without modifying installed configuration.

Jevgrep is a separate opt-in source-discovery lane, not a Jev control-plane replacement. jeo-skill explore requires an explicit root and per-call remote-content consent; native catalog/exact/LSP/zvec/Graphify routes stay default. Published @dzhng/jevgrep@0.8.0 transport passed isolated loopback checks across skills/wiki/graph-source roots (12 POSTs), not live-provider retrieval quality. Twelve focused regressions and independent code/Python reviews passed.

Jev routing (2026-10-08): five-kind backend registry with per-operation allow-list fallback; attestation-bound tiers honored only for calibrated-head drivers (api/systemone) so JSON-from-chat and base-logit paths can never permit; hosted api wire contract fixed; cap-aware skill selection with explicit none; manifest-only model_policies drive advisory routing; dispatcher bounds state before I/O and never trims. Installed ~/.agents/jev copy left stale by design.

Add FilmCraft as a source-pinned operator skill; publish only HEAD catalog plus FilmCraft from an isolated worktree, preserving concurrent uncommitted skill additions. Skill installation remains separate from app installation, MCP registration and media mutation.

Rebuilt eleven repository operator additions on remote FilmCraft commit 88c2e573 instead of overwriting it: final catalog 355 to 366, all seven catalog gates and eleven skill/discovery checks pass, 44 eval scenarios authored, upstream runtimes not executed

Optional Jev configuration and runtime failures must never change successful skill-install status. Preserve genuine installer errors, one JEV_ENABLED authority per profile, saved API credentials, and truthful session-load versus unregistered package maintenance plans. Verified isolated installers and typed protocol contracts before publication.

Final Jev review reproduced and closed standalone root-controller symlink/non-file and raw native leaf collisions before publication, plus large-input OFF callback EPIPE host crashes. Added exact preservation regressions; final Python 48+64 and Node 53 passes, one explicit live skip, offline 20 checks. Independent JS, Python and installer review approved scoped contracts; no live routing quality, paid API, DB, desktop or persistent registration claim.

Public FULL setup audit at 81131733: authentic 367-skill GitHub transport and native loaders pass, but original guide is not end-to-end verified. Reproduced PATH, non-interactive RTK, Python selection and Ouroboros all/MCP2 profile defects; separate fixture corrections pass. Preserve original failures, reuse/skip/deploy limitations and durable vault raw evidence; no public README/setup patch or push.

Funded TypeSafe source-harness review verified once: API-only POST HTTP200, jev-latest served jev-1.13.0, four exact Noul responses, tokens435/80, latency340ms, proposal_only due below-threshold answers. Keychain credential stayed in private memory/child env; secret-free evidence retained, owned temporary observer/evidence/empty HOME removed, profiles unchanged. Does not prove routing/pruning/calibration or favorable-tier permission downgrade; no provider rerun or new source-code push.

Standardized eleven repository operators as standalone v1.1.0 router/reference/offline-helper packages; Git inspection binds caller roots, allowlists host env and never forwards provider credentials; regressions/CI and discovery metadata stay synchronized without changing unrelated primary work

Verified Jev README contracts against source and installed runtime; installed harness rejects rounded Choice distributions accepted by source; native callbacks remain advisory routing only. No product/config changes or hosted inference.

Implemented and applied Codex Jev assist plus advisory tool review, verified exact trusted hooks via actual app-server and two real model sessions. Native assist/context pruning remain limited to Jev-owned messages; host permission/model boundaries documented.

Fixed latest Ubuntu CI timeout-test race by publishing signal readiness after handler installation and driving only deadline/grace timers deterministically. Retained real child-death and failure-cleanup assertions; no production timeout changes.

Applied measured source-only latency, allocation and resource cleanup optimizations. Preserved catalog bytes and parser/output behavior; CI resource regressions are hermetic and reject skips. Installed runtimes and external Jev plugin edits were left unchanged; model/GPU/full-browser and full existing CI success remain unclaimed.

Refreshed all three README locales from current installer/native-hook/TOON behavior; replaced eight README-only visuals with a genuine Codex cover and two Codex SVGs. Preserved generated catalog/monthly release ownership, fixed consumer-scope examples and duplicate release footer tails. Eight focused checks, fourteen isolated previews and 850px browser text-fit checks passed; missing root LICENSE stays an explicit licensing open item.

Repair model-plan policy implementation instead of removing failing CI tests; bind explicit fresh host observations, strict calendar/quota checks, ordered advisory fallbacks and bounded inputs. No runtime credentials, provider calls or model launches.

macOS CI exposes /var temp alias in owned offline-preflight fixtures. Resolve only the owned TemporaryDirectory base; preserve literal caller paths and every production symlink guard. A deterministic aliased-temp regression failed before the fix; all 15 preflight regressions now pass locally.

Ten named UI-source operators remain adjacent to existing generic UI owners; no supersession is proven. Preserve restricted Canvas/Hyperiux and absent Cursify reuse grants; guide installation never activates upstream runtimes.
